name: Direct Volume Ray Casting with Texture Atlas Voxel Access
definition: A direct volume rendering technique that casts rays through a 3D volume represented as a 2D texture atlas. The volume is sliced into `numberOfSlices` layers, packed into a 2D grid of `slicesOverX` by `slicesOverY` tiles, and accessed via bilinear interpolation in the fragment shader.
summary: Direct Volume Ray Casting with Texture Atlas Voxel Access renders 3D volumes by packing slices into a 2D texture atlas, replacing 3D lookups with 2D access to optimize GPU performance.
